<thought>Based on the formula C6H10O2 and DBE = 2, the structure is likely a six‑membered lactone (one ring and one carbonyl). The SMILES for ε‑caprolactone, which matches these criteria, is O=C1CCCCCO1. This SMILES is valid and corresponds to the given molecular data.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C1CCCCCO1</final_answer>
